'''Isaac Lyons''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[September 2000 Stickney tournament]] on 23 September 2000 with Tatooine Beatdown? and [[There Is Good In Him / I Can Save Him|TIGIH]], according to Edmund Gray's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1265">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-24-stikney-il-9-23-00d1265/ stikney-il-9-23-00], DeckTech (edmund "edmund" gray, 24 September 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-24-stikney-il-9-23-00d1265/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
